synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “who”.
synth.s2: My friend can play the piano.
synth.explain: Use 'who' for a person. 'Who' takes the place of 'my friend'.
synth.say: I have a friend. My friend can play the piano.
synth.full: I have a friend who can play the piano.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “which”.
synth.s2: The kite has a long tail.
synth.explain: Use 'which' for a thing. It takes the place of 'the kite'.
synth.say: Dad bought a kite. The kite has a long tail.
synth.full: Dad bought a kite which has a long tail.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one.
synth.explain: 'Although' shows a surprise: she was tired, yet she still finished. Don't add 'but' after 'although'.
synth.say: Siti was tired. She finished her homework.
synth.full: Although Siti was tired, she finished her homework.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one.
synth.explain: Use 'although' OR 'but', never both in one sentence.
synth.say: The boy fell down. He did not cry.
synth.full: Although the boy fell down, he did not cry.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one.
synth.explain: 'As' can mean 'because'. The reason comes first here.
synth.say: It was very hot. We stayed indoors.
synth.full: As it was very hot, we stayed indoors.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one.
synth.explain: 'While' shows two things happening at the same time.
synth.say: Mum cooked dinner. Dad washed the dishes.
synth.full: While Mum cooked dinner, Dad washed the dishes.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one.
synth.lead: After Jun Wei finished his lunch,
synth.say: Jun Wei finished his lunch. He went out to play.
synth.full: After Jun Wei finished his lunch, he went out to play.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “when”.
synth.explain: 'When' tells us the time something happens.
synth.say: You must wear a helmet. You ride your scooter.
synth.full: You must wear a helmet when you ride your scooter.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Rewrite the sentence starting with the words given. Use “by”.
synth.explain: Passive voice: the mouse comes first, then 'was' + chased + 'by the cat'.
synth.full: The mouse was chased by the cat.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “than”.
synth.explain: Use '-er … than' to compare two people.
synth.say: Tom is tall. Sam is taller.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “grew”.
answers: which our class planted grew into sunflowers
that our class planted grew into sunflowers
our class planted grew into sunflowers
synth.answer: which our class planted grew into sunflowers
synth.explain: Put 'which our class planted' right after 'the seeds', then finish the sentence.
synth.say: Our class planted seeds. The seeds grew into sunflowers.
synth.full: The seeds which our class planted grew into sunflowers.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “both” … “and”.
answers: both to draw and to sing
synth.explain: 'Both … and' joins two things she likes. Keep the two parts the same shape.
synth.say: Hui Min likes to draw. Hui Min likes to sing.
synth.full: Hui Min likes both drawing and singing.

synth.title: Join It Up
synth.q: Join the two sentences into one. Use “for”.
synth.say: We made stars. We made stars for Christmas.
